evidence.description: C1 EDGE/ERROR clause ('drop before any audio → ONE reconnect, else close cleanly') traced by hand and confirmed correctly implemented via the per-invocation `ended` flag + call-scoped `geminiReconnects`/`gotAudio` counters.

Gemini Live confirmed DEFAULT on the Telnyx `start` frame; zero grep hits for playWakeClip/synthWakeClip/buildWakeLine/planVoice/voice-cheap/voice-synth/compositional-*/voice-turn anywhere in apps/life-call.
routeGeminiMessage checks serverContent.interrupted BEFORE parseGeminiAudio; server.js:410-411 routes the resulting {event:'clear'} to the CARRIER socket via carrierSend, not the Gemini socket.
/health, /test-call, /telegram, /inbound-email, /api/inngest, /api/stripe/webhook all present and unchanged in shape; ctxFromReq, MAX_CONCURRENT, startRecording all present.
still on disk, shelved not deleted, per spec.

`let ended = false;` is declared INSIDE openGeminiLive(), so each invocation (including the recursive reconnect call) gets a fresh closure binding — the paired error+close for socket #1 is now suppressed after the first fires, and socket #2 (the reconnect) has its OWN independent ended flag. Traced by hand for all 4 required scenarios: (1) pre-audio drop → reconnect once; (2) reconnect socket also fails pre-audio → geminiReconnects=1 → decideGeminiEnd returns close, no 2nd retry, no infinite loop; (3) post-audio drop (gotAudio=true) → close, never reconnect; (4) carrierOpen=false → close (no-op close on already-dead carrier, caught by try/catch).
decideGeminiEnd is pure: (!gotAudio && reconnects<maxReconnects(1) && carrierOpen) → reconnect, else close. Matches C1 EDGE/ERROR exactly.

decideGeminiEnd + carrierActionForGeminiKind extracted as pure, testable helpers consistent with this feature's own established pattern (routeGeminiMessage 'testable with a fake socket', call-bridge.cjs:36). The remaining inline code in server.js is minimal, necessarily-effectful WebSocket lifecycle glue (register 4 listeners, call the pure decision fn, close a socket) — a reasonable thin-shell/tested-core split for this class of code.
